verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service platform. Surfacing AI-generated insights from a customer's financial or operational data is a capability such a platform could plausibly ship, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows AI-generated insights or suggestions. The 'complete data visibility' claim is an adjacent operational dashboard, not AI insight. The llms.txt file serves documentation to LLMs and is not an in-product insight feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
